context: A boss mentors a uni intern about journalism
purpose: Teach: 岡山/マリア/ホームズ/トニー/カメラマン/フォード/マルクス/マドリッド

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、地方取材で岡山行くなら、文芸サークルのマリアさん紹介する。
lines.en: Ren, if you're heading to Okayama for the field reporting, I'll introduce you to Maria from the literary circle.
lines.style: Casual mentor-to-mentee tone. Measured pace, practical. Opening with the name like you're catching someone's attention before the actual information. Matter-of-fact helpfulness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。ホームズ風の推理特集、地元紙にも記事を載せたいです。
lines.en: Yes, thank you. I was hoping to get a Holmes-style mystery feature in the local paper too.
lines.style: Eager but measured—not gushing. Quick intake at the start. Respectful energy, slightly formal register matching the mentee-addressing-mentor dynamic. Thoughtful pacing on the secondary clause.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 同時期、映画祭審査員のトニーさんが来日する。
lines.en: Around that same time, Tony—the film festival jury member—will be visiting Japan.
lines.style: Informative, opening with calm authority. Slight emphasis on 'around that same time' to flag the coincidence. Even delivery, no rush. The tone of someone connecting dots for someone younger.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: カメラマンの取材も、合わせて行えそうですか。
lines.en: Would it be possible to coordinate the camera crew coverage with that timing?
lines.style: Thoughtful question, genuine probe. Slightly careful phrasing—testing feasibility without overstepping. Pause before the final clause. Respectful but not tentative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。フォード財団からの招聘もあって、滞在は長い。
lines.en: Yes, it should work out. He's here on a Ford Foundation invitation, so his stay will be quite long.
lines.style: Reassuring affirmation at the start, then matter-of-fact expansion. Flat delivery on the institutional detail—it's just information, not a big deal. Slight downward trail at the end, suggesting 'so you have room to work.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 背景に、マルクス経済学の議論もあるそうで、文化欄にも。
lines.en: There's also Marxist economics discussion in the background, so that could work for the culture section too.
lines.style: Thoughtful addition, opening with a small exploratory tone—'there's also.' Speaking to what Ren might not have considered yet. Gentle upward lilt on 'too,' inviting him to see the angle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: マドリッドからの中継、編集と調整しろ。
lines.en: Coordinate with editing on the live feed from Madrid.
lines.style: Shift to direct instruction, crisp and purposeful. Opening with the verb—this is now task-focused. No softening, but not harsh. Brief and clear, the tone of someone delegating with confidence.
